meta.name: dnanexus-integration
meta.description: Build and operate reproducible genomics workloads on DNAnexus with the dx CLI, dxpy, apps/applets, native workflows, dxCompiler, and Nextflow. Use for DNAnexus data transfers, dxapp.json development, execution monitoring, workflow import, and project automation.

copy.tagline: 在DNAnexus上构建和运行可复现的基因组学工作流
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在DNAnexus平台上自动化基因组学数据处理和运行分析流程
copy.tagline_en: Build and run reproducible genomics workflows on DNAnexus
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate genomics data processing and run analysis pipelines on the DNAnexus platform

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能通过 dx CLI 和 dxpy 在 DNAnexus 云平台上处理基因组学任务，包括创建 app/applet、上传下载文件、运行和监控作业、导入工作流，并生成相应代码和配置。
howto.when: 当用户要求进行 DNAnexus 数据上传下载、构建 app/applet、运行或监控作业，或进行项目自动化等操作时触发。

say.text: 创建一个处理 FASTQ 文件的 dxapp.json 配置。
say.note: 会生成符合规范的 dxapp.json。

say.text: 监控 applet-xxxx 这个作业的状态和日志。
say.note: 会查询作业状态并输出日志。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use dx CLI and dxpy on DNAnexus to handle genomics tasks: create apps/applets, upload/download files, run and monitor jobs, import workflows, and generate code and configs.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to perform DNAnexus data transfers, build apps/applets, run or monitor jobs, or automate projects.

say_en.text: Use dxpy to upload local sample.fastq to project-xxxx.
say_en.note: Uploads via dxpy and returns a file ID.

say_en.text: Create a dxapp.json config for processing FASTQ files.
Monitor the status and logs of applet-xxxx.
say_en.note: Queries job status and shows logs.
